title: Absolute Fresh
description: This project delivers an absolute vanilla Minecraft experience. It is enhanced with fresh animations that make the game feel smooth and visually appealing. With minimal extra tweaks, it keeps the core gameplay intact while improving the overall feel.
body: This modpack ads Fresh Animations to you and mobs around you, also adding smal detail to the game making it more 3D giving it a nicer look. If you are looking for vanilla mods that makes the game 3D and fell good then this is the one for you. If you do not like to have fun then i would not recommend this pack
